verdict.rationale: Cerebras documents a catalog of open-source models on its public shared endpoints, with a model-selection guide. Qwen 3.8 27B is explicitly listed on the public shared tier and is corroborated by community use. A Llama 3.1 70B comparison suggests Llama has also been served. The evidence does not show how broad the catalog is: DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and other named families never appear. Missing for 10: an explicit list of model families (Llama, DeepSeek, GPT-OSS and peers) currently on shared endpoints, and evidence of catalog breadth and currency.
